changes.evidence: In the 1994 series' Secret Wars arc (#61 to #63) the Beyonder's planet is never called Battleworld; the episode and character summaries call it a far-off or unknown alien planet, and Battleworld is the comics' name. The stage text already says 'the Beyonder's world'.
